Name: The Trials of the Teleporting Totems
Author: zilchaz
Description:
The new way to learn the power of Warping Magic.

Playing with a new save is recommended for immersion purposes.

[font=Arial][color=#ea9999][size=5]Features[/size][/color][/font]
[font=Arial][size=4]Bundles[/size][/font]
Instead of learning Warp Totem recipes by reaching a skill level, the Wizard will introduce you to the lore of warping magic.

You must complete a bundle to gain totemic knowledge. There are five bundles in total, unlocked in the following sequence:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*] Mountain[/*]
[*]Beach[/*]
[*]Desert[/*]
[*]Island[/*]
[*]???[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[font=Arial][size=4]Unlock Return Scepter[/size][/font]
Instead of buying the Return Scepter from Krobus directly. You must meet conditions before Krobus will offer the Return Scepter in his shop.

[font=Arial][color=#ea9999][size=5]Events Condition[/size][/color][/font]
[spoiler]
[size=4][b]Totemic Bundle Intro[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] In Mountain[/*]
[*]Time: 9 PM - 12 PM[/*]
[*]Foraging skill level 6[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Unlock Return Scepter[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] In Sewer[/*]
[*]Must have at least 6 hearts with [b]Krobus[/b][/*]
[*]Completed 3 Totemic Warp Point bundles (Mountain, Beach, and Desert)[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[font=Arial][size=4]Unlock Rain Totem (New in Ver.2.0.0)[/size][/font]
Linus will request you for something after you reach Forage lvl.9. Complete the quest and he'll teach you.
